verdicts.reason: A keeps the OBSIDIAN logo at a readable size, but the logo floats near the canvas center instead of over the text column. The Shop button is pushed left of the centered headline/price axis, and there is dead space along the bottom. B gets the alignment right (headline, price and button share one center axis), but it shrinks the logo to an illegible ~5px wordmark, so the brand is effectively lost. That failure is worse than A's button misalignment.
